name: @neuropause/business
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Wave 8 Enterprise Business Platform & Enterprise Applications. Composes Waves 1-7 (unchanged) into a complete enterprise business operating system: CRM, sales, customer success, ERP core (double-entry posting engine), accounting, payroll, banking, tax, procurement, inventory, manufacturing, healthcare, HR, project portfolio, assets, and compliance — plus business AI integration, business automation, executive dashboards, and enterprise APIs. Domain runtimes and engines are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process over data supplied at runtime; external systems (SAP/Oracle/Dynamics/NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero/Workday/ADP/Stripe/PayPal/Razorpay/Plaid/Epic/Cerner/FHIR/HL7/MES/SCADA) are ADAPTER-VERIFIED shapes never executed; real customers/revenue/invoices/inventory/projects/assets/financials/HR/payroll are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING (registries start empty; never fabricated); payroll processing, government tax filing, bank transfers, healthcare EHR, insurance claims, manufacturing execution, legal filings, compliance certification, and payment settlement are REGULATED-EXTERNAL and never executed or claimed. One new additive package; every business operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id and evidence level.
